=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:493-508 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate-supersede statuses memo in `_pr_checks_completed` (`all(.[]; (type != "object") or (.state != "pending"))`) caches only when no entry in the whole statuses history is `pending`. The decision jq at 516-519 reads only the newest `ai-review/head-gate` status, so the memo is cleared whenever any old or unrelated pending entry is in the list.
  WHY: The history always holds an old pending `ai-review/head-gate` entry (scripts/review_head_gate.sh:85/87). `_pr_final_ci_merge_pending_mark` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2639-2641) also posts a pending `ai-review/final-ci-merge-pending` status that is never resolved. So the statuses GET runs on every poll, and the issue goal "Commit statuses are read once per head SHA per invocation, unless a status is still pending" is never met on real heads. `test_a_pending_status_is_re_read_every_tick` locks in the too-broad rule. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1203-1208 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_checks_wait_read` returns the non-zero exit of `gh_retry gh_read --same-repo-only api "$@"` straight away and never falls back to `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq`.
  WHY: `gh_read` belongs to issue #9897, which is still open, and its stated signature is `gh_read [--same-repo-only]` with no `api` subcommand. A shape mismatch or a token failure would make every routed read fail, so waits end in query_failed/timeout and auto-merge is refused in the source repo and every consumer. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:356-363, 1217-1224 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The check-runs and workflow-runs back-off fingerprints keep only `[id, (status == "completed"), conclusion]` and drop the exact `status`, so a queued -> in_progress change leaves the fingerprint the same.
  WHY: `_pr_wait_backoff_step` (line 1227) treats the changed snapshot as stable and doubles the interval instead of resetting it to the base, which delays the next read by up to the cap. All four flagging reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagrees and says this is not a defect, because the transition cannot change the outcome.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1201-1213 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_checks_wait_read` moves per-poll reads between the PAT and the job token based only on whether `type gh_read` succeeds. There is no workflow-level switch to turn routing off, and no audit signal (env exports at `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1182, 4724, 4844`).
  WHY: An operator who needs the PAT path for a consumer cannot turn routing off without renaming the function or unsetting `GH_READ_TOKEN`, and a mis-shaped `gh_read` is trusted silently.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:499-507 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The gate-supersede statuses memo in `_pr_checks_completed` stores the response only when no entry in the whole list is `pending`. The list includes superseded entries: `ai-review/head-gate` pending (scripts/review_head_gate.sh:85 and :87, later success at scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:312) and `_pr_final_ci_merge_pending_mark` (line 2640) pending. So the else branch at :505-506 always clears the memo.
  WHY: The statuses GET runs on every poll and the issue goal is never met. The tests pass only because the fixtures have no superseded pending entry, and test_a_pending_status_is_re_read_every_tick locks in the over-broad rule. Decisions are unaffected. Suggested fix: decide on the newest status of `$ctx` via `max_by([(.created_at // ""), (.id // 0)])`, about 3 lines.
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh _pr_checks_wait_read, lines 1201-1213
  PROBLEM: `gh_read` is not defined yet (#9897 is open), and the `api` + `--paginate --slurp` call shape is pinned only by the test stub. A different shape would turn every routed read into query_failed/timeout and refuse auto-merge.
  WHY: Suggested fix: fall through to `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq "$@"` on non-zero, or add a contract assertion against scripts/gh_helpers.sh. Estimated 3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
- Note: says the queued -> in_progress back-off nit is not a defect. GH_READ_TOKEN exposure is already at the same scope as AI_COMMENT_JOB_TOKEN. No task gaps: the two unmet acceptance rows (tests/test_review_final_ci.py, tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py) are inherited failures that also fail on the merge base.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:500-502 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The statuses memo in _pr_checks_completed is too broad and does not cache when superseded 'pending' statuses exist.
  WHY: `all(.[]; ... .state != "pending")` runs over the whole status history (e.g. `ai-review/head-gate`), so the memo is cleared on every poll and the read-once-per-head goal fails.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1205-1207 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_pr_checks_wait_read` returns the error code of `gh_read` immediately and never falls back to `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq`.
  WHY: If `gh_read` or the job token fails, the required-checks wait fails and auto-merge is blocked, even though the PAT fallback is available.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1217-1224 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The fingerprint in _pr_wait_backoff_step tracks only the completed flag and the conclusion, not the `status`.
  WHY: A queued -> in_progress change leaves the fingerprint unchanged, so the back-off doubles instead of resetting and the auto-merge is delayed.
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh _pr_checks_wait_read (lines 1205-1213)
  PROBLEM: The router has no fail-safe fallback to `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq` when `gh_read` fails.
  WHY: Suggested fix: run gh_read and fall through to `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq "$@"` on failure. Estimated 5 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1203-1208 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_pr_checks_wait_read` hard-codes `gh_retry gh_read --same-repo-only api "$@"`, but #9897 is still open and specs `gh_read [--same-repo-only]` with no `api` subcommand. A non-zero exit returns immediately (line 1206-1208) without trying `_safe_gh_jq`.
  WHY: Any shape drift makes every routed read fail, so the wait ends in `outcome=query_failed`/`outcome=timeout` and auto-merge is refused in the source repo and in consumers.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:493-508 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The statuses memo engages only when no entry is `pending`, yet `ai-review/final-ci-merge-pending` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2639-2641) and superseded `ai-review/head-gate` entries (scripts/review_head_gate.sh:85/87, later succeeded by review_enable_auto_merge.sh:312 or scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2609) stay pending. The decision jq at lines 516-519 picks the newest entry via `max_by`.
  WHY: The memo never engages in production, so issue #9926's read-once goal and the ">= 50% cut" in PAT calls are not reached. `tests/test_pr_checks_lib_wait_backoff.py::StatusesMemo::test_statuses_are_read_once_per_head_when_none_is_pending` passes only because of its fixture, and `test_a_pending_status_is_re_read_every_tick` locks in the broad rule with `ctx="other"`.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:356-363 and line 1222 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both fingerprints reduce each run to `[id, (status == "completed"), conclusion]` and drop the actual status.
  WHY: On a queued -> in_progress change, `_pr_wait_backoff_step` (line 1227) sees no change and keeps doubling, delaying reads by up to `AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_POLL_MAX_SECONDS - AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_POLL_SECONDS` (default 120 s).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1201-1213 and `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1182, 4724, 4844` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The router switches per-poll reads between the PAT and job-token trust boundaries based on `type gh_read`, with no audit signal and no workflow-level disable switch.
  WHY: An operator cannot turn routing off without renaming the function or unsetting `GH_READ_TOKEN`, and a mis-shaped `gh_read` is trusted silently.
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh _pr_checks_wait_read, lines 1201-1213
  PROBLEM: A non-zero exit from `gh_read` returns immediately without trying the PAT path.
  WHY: Suggested fix: fall through to `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq "$@"`. About 3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:356-362 and 1222 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The back-off fingerprint records only whether each check-run or workflow run is completed, not its exact status.
  WHY: A queued -> in_progress change leaves the fingerprint unchanged, so the interval doubles instead of resetting, against the stated reset-on-change behaviour.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:499-507; the decision later filters to `ai-review/head-gate` at 516-519 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The statuses memo declines to cache when any returned status is `pending`, whatever its context and whether or not it is superseded.
  WHY: The response holds history, and pending entries persist: `ai-review/head-gate` (`scripts/review_head_gate.sh:85`) and `ai-review/final-ci-merge-pending` (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2639-2640`). So the GET repeats on every poll even when the newest gate status is no longer pending.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:line 501 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The gate-supersede statuses memo clears itself whenever any status is `pending`, not only `ai-review/head-gate`, which is the context the decision jq at lines 516-520 reads. `_pr_final_ci_merge_pending_mark` (pr_checks_lib.sh:2639-2640) posts a pending status that is never resolved, and superseded pending head-gate statuses accumulate (scripts/review_autofix_step_deterministic_skip_security_pass.sh:81; review_sweep_head_gate.sh:11 records 40 head-gate statuses on one head).
  WHY: `_pr_wait_statuses_sha` stays empty and the `commits/<sha>/statuses` read runs on every poll for the whole budget. The requirement is unmet, part of the >= 50% PAT cut is lost, and `test_a_pending_status_is_re_read_every_tick` locks in the broad rule. Suggested fix: restrict the check to the newest `${gate_sup_status_ctx}` status via `max_by([(.created_at // ""), (.id // 0)])`, about 3 lines. (2 related items: reported twice, verbatim duplicate.)
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:lines 356-362 and line 1222 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The check-run and workflow-run fingerprints (`map([(.id // 0), ((.status // "") == "completed"), (.conclusion // null)])`) are byte-identical across a queued -> in_progress change.
  WHY: `_pr_wait_backoff_step` (line 1227) sees `backoff_fp = last_fp` and doubles the interval instead of resetting, delaying the next check by up to `AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_POLL_MAX_SECONDS` (180 s). Outcomes stay correct. (2 related items: reported twice, verbatim duplicate.)
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh _pr_checks_wait_read, lines 1203-1211
  PROBLEM: `gh_retry gh_read --same-repo-only api "$@"` hard-codes the argument shape of a helper that does not exist yet (#9897). Drift would turn check-runs into `{}` (reason=query_failed) and leave the runs listing unread, so wai
